previous.changeLog: Coexists with other Gameface mods. The bar now detects which garage sub-views are already occupied and places itself on the first free one, so it no longer blanks out (or gets blanked by) other Gameface-based mods. If you ran into two garage bars fighting over the same spot, this fixes it.

current.changeLog: Correct research XP cost on convergent tech-tree nodes. Vehicle unlocks are now priced from the game's own tech-tree data (cheapest-available parent, with any blueprint discount already applied) instead of the currently-selected vehicle's edge. On a vehicle reachable from more than one parent with different costs the bar's confirmation dialog previously showed a higher XP cost than the native research button and could have overcharged the unlock. Both now match the game exactly.
